correctness.rationale: For all q≥2 and k≥1 the length-qk k-universal words are precisely k permutation arches. An absent (k+1)-word has weakly nonincreasing ranks at every adjacent target pair in successive permutation blocks. Therefore S=1^T H_1...H_k 1, giving E S=q((q+1)/2)^k. On diagonal/off-diagonal ordered pair orbits the exact expected tensor transfer is T=[[ (q+1)/2,(q²−1)/3 ],[ (q+1)/3,(q+1)(3q−2)/12 ]]. Trace and determinant yield v_0=q², v_1=q²((q+1)/2)², v_{k+2}=((q+1)(3q+4)/12)v_{k+1}−((q+1)²(q+2)/72)v_k. Positive Perron eigenvector and sqrt(q(9q+16))>3q+2 imply lambda_+>((q+1)/2)² and exponential positive relative-variance growth. The rank strict/weak boundary, q=2, and formal k=0 were checked; finite tests are not the general proof.
